ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select * from dbo.sysobjects where id = object_id(N'CDN.WykrywajKonflikty_DanePrc') and OBJECTPROPERTY(id, N'IsProcedure') = 1) drop procedure CDN.WykrywajKonflikty_DanePrc

CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.WykrywajKonflikty_DanePrc @SourceName VARCHAR(255), @SourceDatabase VARCHAR(255) AS BEGIN
DECLARE @sql varchar(max)
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM TEMPDB..SYSOBJECTS WHERE ID = OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..##KONFLIKTY') AND TYPE = 'U') DROP TABLE ##KONFLIKTY
CREATE TABLE ##KONFLIKTY( ID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, OPTIMAID INT, OptimaAkronim VARCHAR(20), OptimaImie VARCHAR(30), OptimaDrugieImie NVARCHAR(30), OptimaNazwisko VARCHAR(40), OptimaMiasto VARCHAR(40), OptimaPoczta VARCHAR(40), OptimaKodPocztowy VARCHAR(10), OptimaUlica VARCHAR(40), OptimaNrDomu VARCHAR(10), OptimaNrLokalu VARCHAR(10), OptimaHDKTelefon1 VARCHAR(20), OptimaNipE VARCHAR(20), OptimaPesel VARCHAR(11), OptimaHDKTelefon2 VARCHAR(20), OptimaHDKEmail VARCHAR(127), OptimaIDWydzialu INT, OptimaFormaWyplaty INT, OptimaFormaWyplatyTyp INT, OptimaFormaWyplatyNazwa VARCHAR(20), OptimaBank INT, OptimaNrRachunku VARCHAR(51), OptimaNRB TINYINT, OptimaBankAkronim VARCHAR(20), OptimaBankNumer VARCHAR(10), OptimaBankIBAN INT, OptimaBankNazwa1 VARCHAR(50), OptimaBankNazwa2 VARCHAR(50), OptimaBankSwift VARCHAR(20), OptimaBankMiasto VARCHAR(40), OptimaBankKodPocztowy VARCHAR(10), OptimaBankUlica VARCHAR(40), OptimaBankKraj VARCHAR(40), OptimaBankWojewodztwo VARCHAR(40), OptimaBankTelefon VARCHAR(20), OptimaBankFax VARCHAR(20), XLOptimaID INT, XLAkronim VARCHAR(20), XLImie VARCHAR(30), XLDrugieImie VARCHAR(30), XLNazwisko VARCHAR(40), XLID INT, XLMiasto VARCHAR(40), XLPoczta VARCHAR(40), XLKodPocztowy VARCHAR(10), XLUlica VARCHAR(40), XLNrDomu VARCHAR(10), XLNrLokalu VARCHAR(10), XLHDKTelefon1 VARCHAR(20), XLNipE VARCHAR(20), XLPesel VARCHAR(11), XLHDKTelefon2 VARCHAR(20), XLHDKEmail VARCHAR(127), XLIDWydzialu INT, XLOptimaIDWydzialu INT, XLFormaWyplaty INT, xlFormaWyplatyNazwa VARCHAR(20), XLBank INT, XLNrRachunku VARCHAR(51), XLNRB INT, XLBankAkronim VARCHAR(20), XLBankNumer VARCHAR(10), XLBankIBAN INT, XLBankNazwa1 VARCHAR(50), XLBankSwift VARCHAR(20), XLBankMiasto VARCHAR(40), XLBankKodPocztowy VARCHAR(10), XLBankUlica VARCHAR(40), XLBankKraj VARCHAR(40), XLBankWojewodztwo VARCHAR(40), XLBankTelefon VARCHAR(20), XLBankFax VARCHAR(20), OptimaArchwialny TINYINT )
SELECT @sql = ' insert into ##KONFLIKTY SELECT ISNULL(oPrc.PRE_PraId,0) as OptimaID, ISNULL(oPrc.PRE_Kod,'''') as OptimaAkronim, ISNULL(oPrc.PRE_Imie1,'''') as OptimaImie, ISNULL(oPrc.PRE_Imie2,'''') as OptimaDrugieImie, ISNULL(oPrc.PRE_Nazwisko,'''') as OptimaNazwisko, ISNULL(oPrc.PRE_MLDMiasto,'''') as OptimaMiasto, ISNULL(oPrc.PRE_MLDPoczta,'''') as OptimaPoczta, ISNULL(oPrc.PRE_MLDKodPocztowy,'''') as OptimaKodPocztowy, ISNULL(oPrc.PRE_MLDUlica,'''') as OptimaUlica, ISNULL(oPrc.PRE_MLDNrDomu,'''') as OptimaNrDomu, ISNULL(oPrc.PRE_MLDNrLokalu,'''') as OptimaNrLokalu, ISNULL(oPrc.PRE_HDKTelefon1,'''') as OptimaHDKTelefon1, ISNULL(oPrc.PRE_NipE,'''') as OptimaNipE, ISNULL(oPrc.PRE_Pesel,'''') as OptimaPesel, ISNULL(oPrc.PRE_HDKTelefon2,'''') as OptimaHDKTelefon2, ISNULL(oPrc.PRE_HDKEmail,'''') as OptimaHDKEmail, ISNULL(oPrc.PRE_DzlId,0) as OptimaIDWydzialu, ISNULL(oSch.SPL_FPLID,0) as OptimaFormaWyplaty, ISNULL(oFPl.FPL_Typ,0) as OptimaFormaWyplatyTyp, ISNULL(oFPl.FPL_Nazwa,'''') as OptimaFormaWyplatyNazwa, ISNULL(oSch.SPL_BnaId,0) as OptimaBank, ISNULL(oSch.SPL_RachunekNr,'''') as OptimaNrRachunku, ISNULL(oSch.SPL_IBAN,0) as OptimaNRB, ISNULL(oBnk.BNA_Akronim,'''') as OptimaBankAkronim, ISNULL(oBnk.BNA_Numer,'''') as OptimaBankNumer, ISNULL(oBnk.BNA_IBAN,0) as OptimaBankIBAN, ISNULL(oBnk.BNA_Nazwa1,'''') as OptimaBankNazwa1, ISNULL(oBnk.BNA_Nazwa2,'''') as OptimaBankNazwa2, ISNULL(oBnk.BNA_Swift,'''') as OptimaBankSwift, ISNULL(oBnk.BNA_Miasto,'''') as OptimaBankMiasto, ISNULL(oBnk.BNA_KodPocztowy,'''') as OptimaBankKodPocztowy, ISNULL(oBnk.BNA_Ulica,'''') as OptimaBankUlica, ISNULL(oBnk.BNA_Kraj,'''') as OptimaBankKraj, ISNULL(oBnk.BNA_Wojewodztwo,'''') as OptimaBankWojewodztwo, ISNULL(oBnk.BNA_Telefon,'''') as OptimaBankTelefon, ISNULL(oBnk.BNA_Fax,'''') as OptimaBankFax, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_OptimaId,0) as XLOptimaID, ISNULL(xlPrc.PRC_Akronim,'''') as XLAkronim, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_Imie1,'''') as XLImie, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_Imie2,'''') as XLDrugieImie, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_Nazwisko,'''') as XLNazwisko, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_GIDNumer,0) as XLID, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_Miasto,'''') as XLMiasto, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_Poczta,'''') as XLPoczta, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_KodP,'''') as XLKodPocztowy, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_Ulica,'''') as XLUlica, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_NrDomu,'''') as XLNrDomu, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_NrLokalu,'''') as XLNrLokalu, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_Telefon2,'''') as XLHDKTelefon1, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_NipE,'''') as XLNipE, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_Pesel,'''') as XLPesel, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_Telefon3,'''') as XLHDKTelefon2, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_Email,'''') as XLHDKEmail, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_FrsID,0) as XLIDWydzialu, case when isnull(xlPrc.Prc_FrsID,0) = 2 then 3 else (select isnull(frs_optimaid,0) from cdn.frmstruktura where frs_gidtyp = -4272 and frs_warstwa = 2 and frs_strtyp = 1001 and frs_gidnumer = xlPrc.Prc_FrsID) end as XLOptimaIDWydzialu, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_FormaNr,0) as XLFormaWyplaty, CAST(ISNULL(xlK.Kon_Wartosc,'''') as varchar(20)) as XLFormaWyplatyNazwa, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_BnkNumer,0) as XLBank, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_NrRachunku,'''') as XLNrRachunku, ISNULL(xlPrc.Prc_NRB,0) as XLNRB, ISNULL(xlBnk.BNK_Kod,'''') as XLBankAkronim, ISNULL(xlBnk.BNK_Numer,'''') as XLBankNumer, ISNULL(xlBnk.BNK_NRB,0) as XLBankIBAN, ISNULL(LEFT(xlBnk.BNK_Nazwa,50),'''') as XLBankNazwa1, ISNULL(xlBnk.BNK_Swift,'''') as XLBankSwift, ISNULL(xlBnk.BNK_Miasto,'''') as XLBankMiasto, ISNULL(xlBnk.BNK_KodP,'''') as XLBankKodPocztowy, ISNULL(xlBnk.BNK_Ulica,'''') as XLBankUlica, ISNULL(xlBnk.BNK_Kraj,'''') as XLBankKraj, ISNULL(xlBnk.BNK_Wojewodztwo,'''') as XLBankWojewodztwo, ISNULL(xlBnk.BNK_Telefon,'''') as XLBankTelefon, ISNULL(xlBnk.BNK_Fax,'''') as XLBankFax, ISNULL(oPrcKod.PRA_Archiwalny,0) as OptimaArchwialny
FROM CDN.PrcKarty xlPrc FULL JOIN (select * from ['+@SourceName+'].['+@SourceDatabase+'].CDN.PracEtaty where convert(date,pre_datado) = Convert(Date,''2999-12-31''))oPrc ON isnull(xlPrc.Prc_OptimaId,0) = isnull(oPrc.PRE_PraId,0) LEFT JOIN ['+@SourceName+'].['+@SourceDatabase+'].CDN.SchematPlatnosci oSch on oSch.SPL_PodmiotID = oPrc.PRE_PreId and oSch.spl_podmiottyp = 3 and oSch.SPL_LiczbaPorz = (select MIN(spl_liczbaporz) from ['+@SourceName+'].['+@SourceDatabase+'].cdn.SchematPlatnosci where spl_podmiottyp = 3 and spl_podmiotid = oPrc.PRE_PreId) left join ['+@SourceName+'].['+@SourceDatabase+'].CDN.FormyPlatnosci oFPl on oFPl.FPL_FpLID = oSch.SPL_FplId left join cdn.Konfig xlK on xlK.Kon_Lp = xlPrc.PRC_FormaNr and xlK.Kon_Numer = 736 left join ['+@SourceName+'].['+@SourceDatabase+'].CDN.bnknazwy oBnk on isnull(oBnk.bna_bnaid,0) = isnull(oSch.SPL_BnaId,0) left join cdn.banki xlBnk on isnull(xlBnk.Bnk_GIDNumer,0) = isnull(xlPrc.PRC_BnkNumer,0) left join ['+@SourceName+'].['+@SourceDatabase+'].CDN.PracKod oPrcKod on oPrcKod.PRA_PraId = oPrc.PRE_PreId ORDER BY OptimaID DESC
'
EXEC (@sql)
END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.WykrywajKonflikty_DanePrc TO CDNRaport
